notes.title: 🛠️ Small Update – Brightness Settings + Inventory Fix
notes.notes:
📺 Added brightness settings!
A few players mentioned the game was too dark, so you can now adjust the brightness to your liking.

🧠 Fixed a major bug where organs and trap items weren’t showing up correctly in the inventory after dying or reloading a save. This should now work as intended.

Thanks for the feedback, keep it coming!
The update is live now. 🩸

notes.title: 🔧 Bug Fix – “The Gauntlet” Door Now Opens
notes.notes:
A critical bug caused the door to "The Gauntlet" to lock when it was supposed to unlock, making progression impossible.

This is now fixed. I’m really sorry for the inconvenience it caused, and I appreciate everyone who reported it.

🧪 The updated version is live now. Thanks for sticking with it!

notes.title: 🛠 Small Update – Smoother Movement, Same Tension
notes.notes:
I’ve updated the moving platform room!

🚶‍♂️ No more awkward jumping. The platforms now let you walk across, but you still need to time it right to make it through.
The old jumping felt too much like a platformer, and it didn’t fit the tone. This should feel more natural and intense, without the frustration.

Thanks for all the feedback, more tweaks are on the way!

notes.title: 🚨 Official Release Build is Live! 🚨
notes.notes:
The moment has arrived! Dr. Gloom’s Lab is officially released on Steam!

This update brings:
🧪 Final polish and tweaks
🎮 Improved stability and performance
🔧 A few last-minute bug fixes
💥 Fully playable from start to finish

This is the build I’ve been working toward, built solo, fueled by your support and feedback.
If you’ve played the demo, now’s the time to jump into the full experience.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Now get in there and survive!
